title: Log an expense from home and see it reflected immediately
description: This verifies that a user can create an expense from the home screen and immediately see the safe-to-spend and history update.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the floating action button
Select an expense transaction type
Fill a valid amount into the amount field
Select a category
Fill a note into the note field
Confirm the transaction
Verify the safe-to-spend value is updated
Verify the new transaction appears in history

title: Unlock the app with a valid PIN
description: A returning user can enter the correct PIN and reach the app content after the unlock gate.

steps.description: Navigate to /unlock
Fill in the PIN field with a valid PIN
Submit the PIN
Verify the app content is displayed
Verify the unlock gate is no longer blocking access

title: Create and confirm a PIN during onboarding
description: This test verifies that a user can create a 4-digit PIN, confirm it successfully, and continue to the next onboarding step.

steps.description: Navigate to /pin
Enter a valid 4-digit PIN
Continue to the confirmation step
Re-enter the same 4-digit PIN for confirmation
Submit the confirmation
Verify the quick setup step is shown

title: Continue into the app when keychain read is unreadable
description: If the unlock gate cannot read stored keychain data, the user still continues into the app instead of getting stuck.

steps.description: Navigate to /unlock
Verify the app content is displayed
Verify the unlock gate does not strand the user

title: Log income from home without choosing a category
description: This verifies that a user can create an income transaction from the home screen without a category and see the result reflected immediately.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the floating action button
Select an income transaction type
Fill a valid amount into the amount field
Confirm the transaction
Verify the safe-to-spend value is updated
Verify the new transaction appears in history

title: Lock the PIN pad after repeated wrong attempts
description: Five wrong PIN attempts trigger a temporary lockout and prevent further unlocking until the lockout expires.

steps.description: Navigate to /unlock
Fill in the PIN field with an invalid PIN
Submit the PIN
Repeat the wrong PIN submission until the lockout state appears
Verify a lockout state is visible
Verify the PIN pad is disabled

title: Complete quick setup with wallet and budget
description: This test verifies that a first-time user can create the initial wallet, budget period, and budget amount and then reach the all-set step.

steps.description: Navigate to /quick-setup
Fill in a wallet name
Select a valid period start date
Fill in a valid budget amount
Submit the quick setup form
Verify the all-set step is shown

steps.description: Navigate to /

Verify the balance summary is displayed

steps.description: Navigate to /welcome
Fill in the display name field with a valid name
Submit the onboarding form
Verify the PIN creation step is shown

steps.description: Navigate to /all-set

Verify the onboarding summary no longer blocks access

category: Home screen with safe to spend

Click the floating action button to open transaction entry

Verify the home dashboard remains in place behind the sheet

title: Handle a mismatched PIN confirmation
description: This test verifies that a mismatched confirmation PIN is rejected and the user remains on the PIN step with clear feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /pin
Enter a valid 4-digit PIN
Continue to the confirmation step
Re-enter a different 4-digit PIN for confirmation
Submit the confirmation
Verify a PIN confirmation error is visible

title: Prevent double submission while a transaction is being processed

Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form

Select an expense transaction type
Fill a valid amount into the amount field
Select a category
Click the confirm action twice in quick succession
Verify the confirm action becomes disabled during submission
Verify only one new transaction appears in history
